s.zh: 野外刷新 DND 野兽
s.en: Spawn DND beasts in the wild

s.zh: 猫头鹰熊、邪座狼、冬狼、地狱犬、魔化兽、闪光犬，以及伪龙、翼猫、巨型火甲虫、罗斯牛、鹰头马身兽、斧喙鸟、狮鹫、钩爪恐兽、相位蜘蛛、暗斗篷、血蝠蝇会在各自的生态区野外刷新，其中凶猛的也会以狂暴兽群出现。关闭后不再刷新、也不会以狂暴兽群出现；保存设置后立即生效，已经在地图上的野兽不受影响。
s.en: Owlbears, worgs, winter wolves, hell hounds, fiendish beasts, blink dogs, as well as pseudodragons, tressyms, giant fire beetles, rothé, hippogriffs, axe beaks, griffons, hook horrors, phase spiders, darkmantles and stirges spawn in the wild in their biomes, and the fierce ones also appear as manhunter packs. When off, they no longer spawn or appear as manhunter packs; takes effect immediately after saving settings, beasts already on the map are unaffected.

s.zh: 野生和非玩家的动物出现时带「野性等级」：狂暴兽群和敌对组按威胁点数定级，野外动物 1～殖民地最高等级 −3，上限殖民地最高等级 +3。等级越高近战伤害、部位生命越高、跑得越快（与殖民者同一条六维曲线，1 级不变）。玩家的动物靠战斗和搬运成长。关闭后不再给新动物定级，已有的等级不提供效果。
s.en: Wild and non-player animals spawn with a "wild level": manhunter packs and hostile groups are leveled by threat points, wild animals 1 to colony's highest level −3, capped at colony's highest level +3. Higher levels mean more melee damage, more part health and faster movement (the same six-ability curve as colonists; level 1 unchanged). Player animals grow through combat and hauling. When off, new animals aren't leveled and existing levels give no effect.

s.zh: 野兽出现时成为精英（恐怖 / 狂暴 / 远古 / 深渊腐化）的概率，死后掉落兽王之心。狂暴兽群的首领总是精英。
s.en: Chance for a spawning beast to become elite (dread / berserk / ancient / abyss-tainted), dropping a beast king's heart on death. Manhunter pack leaders are always elite.

s.zh: DND 生物按挑战等级定级
s.en: DND creatures leveled by challenge rating

s.zh: DND 生物（显示挑战等级 CR 的怪物和野兽）的野性等级至少等于它的 CR，驯服后也保留：CR N 的生物和 N 级冒险者一样成长，部位生命 = 原版 × 等级成长 × 体质，近战伤害随力量提高。塔拉斯克另有事件强化，不受影响。关闭后新出现的生物不再按 CR 定级，已有的等级不变。
s.en: A DND creature (monsters and beasts that show a challenge rating) has a wild level of at least its CR, kept after taming: a CR N creature grows like a level N adventurer, with part health = vanilla × level growth × constitution and melee damage rising with strength. The tarrasque has its own event scaling and is not affected. When off, new creatures are no longer leveled by CR; existing levels stay.
